summary: E1 is class-4 indirect evidence: the teacher who crosses the area reports that its use stopped after an armed-group camp and has not resumed. As a first-hand report it is a target under the pilot criteria; technical survey is unavailable, so clearance is the permitted next step. This does not confirm EO presence.
flags: For sign-off: E1 is indirect, not direct, evidence; the recommendation follows the target rule and is not a finding that EO is confirmed.
The recorded past accident is within 1 km, not stated to be inside this area; the zone visit flag and priority are not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: people stopped using the land near the old path to the school after an armed group camped there around 2004, and nobody has used it since.
E1.note: The report of prolonged land non-use following an armed-group camp suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO; the teacher crosses the area and provides first-hand local information.
